name: 合約與法律
description: 涵蓋商務合約核心詞彙，包括條款結構、義務履行、違約救濟與知識產權授權等必備概念。

words.definitionZh: 由雙方簽署、具法律效力的正式合約

examples.sentence: Both parties signed the agreement before the project began.
examples.translationZh: 雙方在專案開始前簽署了協議。

words.definitionZh: 合約中規範特定事項的單一條款

examples.sentence: The termination clause allows either party to exit with 30 days' notice.
examples.translationZh: 終止條款允許任一方提前30天通知後退出。

words.definitionZh: 合約的約定期限或基本條件

examples.sentence: The contract has a two-year term with an option to renew.
examples.translationZh: 合約期限為兩年，並有續約選項。

words.definitionZh: 合約義務得以觸發或生效的前提要件

examples.sentence: Payment is a condition for delivery of the goods.
examples.translationZh: 付款是貨物交付的前提條件。

words.definitionZh: 合約中各方依法須履行的責任

examples.sentence: The supplier has an obligation to deliver on the agreed date.
examples.translationZh: 供應商有義務在約定日期交貨。

words.definitionZh: 合約中的簽約當事方

examples.sentence: Neither party may assign its rights without written consent.
examples.translationZh: 未經書面同意，任何一方均不得轉讓其權利。

words.definitionZh: 合約的副本，各方各執一份且具同等效力

examples.sentence: The contract was signed in two counterparts, one for each party.
examples.translationZh: 合約簽署了兩份副本，各方各持一份。

words.definitionZh: 正式在合約上簽名的人或機構

examples.sentence: Each signatory must initial every page of the agreement.
examples.translationZh: 每位簽署人須在協議的每一頁縮寫簽名。

words.definitionZh: 正式完成簽署手續使合約生效

examples.sentence: The CEO will execute the contract at tomorrow's signing ceremony.
examples.translationZh: 執行長將在明天的簽約典禮上正式簽署合約。

words.definitionZh: 透過法律手段強制要求對方遵守合約

examples.sentence: The company took legal action to enforce the payment terms.
examples.translationZh: 公司採取法律行動以強制執行付款條款。

words.definitionZh: 違反合約規定義務的行為

examples.sentence: Failure to deliver on time constitutes a breach of contract.
examples.translationZh: 未能準時交貨構成違約。

words.definitionZh: 違約時受害方可依法採取的救濟手段

examples.sentence: Damages are the most common remedy for breach of contract.
examples.translationZh: 損害賠償是違約最常見的救濟方式。

words.definitionZh: 合約中當事方對事實所做的陳述與保證

examples.sentence: The seller's representation that the goods are defect-free was false.
examples.translationZh: 賣方關於貨物無瑕疵的保證陳述是虛假的。

words.definitionZh: 合約中正式承諾須積極作為或不得作為的特別條款

examples.sentence: The non-compete covenant prevents the employee from joining rivals.
examples.translationZh: 競業禁止承諾條款阻止員工加入競爭對手。

words.definitionZh: 對已簽署合約條款所做的正式書面修改

examples.sentence: An amendment was signed to extend the contract by six months.
examples.translationZh: 雙方簽署了修改協議將合約延長六個月。

words.definitionZh: 合約生效後額外簽署的補充條款文件

examples.sentence: The price schedule was attached as an addendum to the main contract.
examples.translationZh: 價格表作為補充文件附於主合約之後。

words.definitionZh: 合約的大型附件，通常含詳細規格或表格

examples.sentence: Technical specifications are listed in Annex A of the agreement.
examples.translationZh: 技術規格列於協議附件A中。

words.definitionZh: 合約中引用的佐證文件，如樣本或圖表

examples.sentence: Exhibit 1 contains the approved list of deliverables.
examples.translationZh: 附件一包含已批准的交付成果清單。

words.definitionZh: 合約末尾附上的補充說明資料，不屬主要條款

examples.sentence: Refer to the appendix for the full list of covered services.
examples.translationZh: 請參閱附錄以獲取涵蓋服務的完整清單。

words.definitionZh: 合約開篇介紹各方身份與訂約宗旨的引言

examples.sentence: The preamble states the intent and background of the agreement.
examples.translationZh: 前言說明了協議的意圖與背景。

words.definitionZh: 鑑於條款中具體說明締約事由的陳述段落

examples.sentence: The recitals describe why the two companies entered the agreement.
examples.translationZh: 陳述段落說明了兩家公司簽訂協議的原因。

words.definitionZh: 合約前言中引導背景陳述的法律用語，意為「鑑於」

examples.sentence: Whereas the parties wish to cooperate, they agree as follows.
examples.translationZh: 鑑於雙方希望合作，特約定如下。

words.definitionZh: 表示「因此」，用於連接前述事實與後續法律結論

examples.sentence: The goods were defective; therefore, the buyer claimed a refund.
examples.translationZh: 貨物有瑕疵，因此買方要求退款。

words.definitionZh: 合約或條款開始正式生效的（用於日期）

examples.sentence: The agreement is effective as of the date of the last signature.
examples.translationZh: 協議自最後一方簽署之日起生效。

words.definitionZh: 合約義務正式開始履行的起始日期

examples.sentence: Work shall begin on the commencement date stated in the contract.
examples.translationZh: 工作應於合約規定的開始日期啟動。

words.definitionZh: 合約期滿自動終止的日期

examples.sentence: A renewal notice must be sent 60 days before the contract's expiry.
examples.translationZh: 必須在合約到期前60天發出續約通知。

words.definitionZh: 合約期滿後雙方同意繼續有效的續簽行為

examples.sentence: Renewal of the service contract requires written approval from both sides.
examples.translationZh: 服務合約續簽需要雙方書面批准。

words.definitionZh: 依合約規定須以書面向對方發出的正式通知

examples.sentence: The vendor gave 30 days' notice before terminating the agreement.
examples.translationZh: 供應商在終止協議前提前30天發出通知。

words.definitionZh: 在合約規定的期限內補救違約情形

examples.sentence: The contractor has 14 days to cure any defects after notification.
examples.translationZh: 承包商在收到通知後有14天的時間修補瑕疵。

words.definitionZh: 主動放棄合約中某項權利的書面聲明

examples.sentence: A written waiver is required to forgo the late payment penalty.
examples.translationZh: 放棄逾期付款罰款需要書面放棄聲明。

words.definitionZh: 對合約變更或特定行為表示同意的聲明

examples.sentence: Written consent from both parties is needed before any subcontracting.
examples.translationZh: 任何分包行為均需雙方書面同意。

words.definitionZh: 正式賦予某人或機構執行特定行為的權力

examples.sentence: Only the CEO is authorized to sign contracts above $100,000.
examples.translationZh: 只有執行長有權簽署超過十萬美元的合約。

words.definitionZh: 法院或仲裁庭依法有權審理案件的地理或法律範圍

examples.sentence: The contract specifies Singapore as the jurisdiction for disputes.
examples.translationZh: 合約指定新加坡為爭議管轄地。

words.definitionZh: 合約準據法條款中指定適用之法律體系的形容詞

examples.sentence: The governing law of this agreement is the law of Hong Kong.
examples.translationZh: 本協議的準據法為香港法律。

words.definitionZh: 合約明定適用的特定國家或地區法律制度

examples.sentence: The contract is governed by the laws of the State of New York.
examples.translationZh: 合約受紐約州法律管轄。

words.definitionZh: 合約雙方就履行或解釋所產生的正式糾紛

examples.sentence: Any dispute arising from this contract shall be resolved by arbitration.
examples.translationZh: 由本合約引發的任何糾紛應透過仲裁解決。

words.definitionZh: 由中立仲裁人以裁決取代訴訟的正式爭議解決程序

examples.sentence: The parties agreed to submit disputes to arbitration in London.
examples.translationZh: 雙方同意將爭議提交倫敦仲裁。

words.definitionZh: 在調解人引導下雙方自願協商和解的非訴訟程序

examples.sentence: They opted for mediation to settle the billing dispute amicably.
examples.translationZh: 他們選擇調解以友好方式解決帳款糾紛。

words.definitionZh: 透過法院起訴程序解決合約爭議

examples.sentence: The company preferred arbitration over costly litigation.
examples.translationZh: 公司傾向仲裁而非耗費龐大的訴訟程序。

words.definitionZh: 具有法律管轄權、正式審理民商事案件的法院

examples.sentence: The case was brought before a court in the agreed jurisdiction.
examples.translationZh: 案件在約定管轄地的法院提起。

words.definitionZh: 處理特定類型爭議的專門仲裁庭或裁判機構

examples.sentence: The arbitral tribunal issued its decision within three months.
examples.translationZh: 仲裁庭在三個月內作出裁決。

words.definitionZh: 法院對訴訟案件所作的最終判決

examples.sentence: The court entered judgment in favor of the plaintiff.
examples.translationZh: 法院作出有利於原告的判決。

words.definitionZh: 仲裁程序終結後仲裁庭的最終裁決結果

examples.sentence: The arbitration award ordered the defendant to pay $50,000.
examples.translationZh: 仲裁裁決命令被告支付五萬美元。

words.definitionZh: 法院命令某方立即停止或避免特定行為的禁令

examples.sentence: The client sought an injunction to stop the release of its data.
examples.translationZh: 客戶申請禁令以阻止其資料的釋出。

words.definitionZh: 合約中約定保護敏感資訊不得向外洩露的義務

examples.sentence: Both sides are bound by strict confidentiality throughout the project.
examples.translationZh: 雙方在整個專案過程中受到嚴格保密義務的約束。

words.definitionZh: 向合約他方揭露資訊或事實

examples.sentence: The vendor must not disclose client data to any third party.
examples.translationZh: 供應商不得向任何第三方揭露客戶資料。

words.definitionZh: 屬於特定公司所有且受法律保護的（資訊或技術）

examples.sentence: Proprietary information shared under this contract must remain secret.
examples.translationZh: 依本合約共享的專有資訊必須保持保密。

words.definitionZh: 與智慧財產（版權、專利、商標等）相關的

examples.sentence: All intellectual property created under this contract belongs to the client.
examples.translationZh: 依本合約創作的所有智慧財產均屬客戶所有。

words.definitionZh: 對原創作品享有的著作財產權

examples.sentence: The copyright for all reports produced belongs to the hiring company.
examples.translationZh: 所有製作報告的著作權屬於委託公司。

words.definitionZh: 用於識別品牌、已向主管機關登記的商標權

examples.sentence: Use of the company's trademark requires prior written approval.
examples.translationZh: 使用公司商標須事先獲得書面批准。

words.definitionZh: 政府授予發明人獨占使用其發明一定期間的專利權

examples.sentence: The supplier holds a patent on the core technology in this product.
examples.translationZh: 供應商持有本產品核心技術的專利。

words.definitionZh: 允許他方在特定條件下使用智慧財產的授權許可

examples.sentence: The software license grants use rights for a period of one year.
examples.translationZh: 軟體授權賦予一年期的使用權。

words.definitionZh: 被授權方依協議向智慧財產權人支付的權利金

examples.sentence: A royalty of 5% of net sales is payable each quarter.
examples.translationZh: 每季須支付淨銷售額5%的權利金。

words.definitionZh: 僅授予單一方、不允許他人共享的（獨家授權）

examples.sentence: The distributor holds an exclusive right to sell in the Asia market.
examples.translationZh: 該經銷商持有亞洲市場的獨家銷售權。

words.definitionZh: 可同時授予多方使用、非獨占性的（授權）

examples.sentence: A nonexclusive license allows several vendors to use the technology.
examples.translationZh: 非獨家授權允許多家廠商使用該技術。

words.definitionZh: 將已獲得的授權再轉授予第三方

examples.sentence: The licensee may not sublicense the software without written consent.
examples.translationZh: 被授權人未經書面同意不得再授權軟體。

words.definitionZh: 將合約中的權利或義務轉讓給第三方的行為

examples.sentence: Assignment of contract rights requires prior approval from the other party.
examples.translationZh: 轉讓合約權利需要對方事先批准。

words.definitionZh: 因重大違約或欺詐而撤銷合約，使其自始無效

examples.sentence: The buyer rescinded the contract after discovering the fraud.
examples.translationZh: 買方在發現欺詐後撤銷了合約。

words.definitionZh: 在法律上從一開始即不具效力的（合約）

examples.sentence: Any contract signed under duress may be declared void.
examples.translationZh: 任何在脅迫下簽署的合約均可宣告無效。

words.definitionZh: 約定補償對方因特定事由所遭受損失的合約義務

examples.sentence: The contract includes an indemnification clause for third-party claims.
examples.translationZh: 合約包含針對第三方索賠的損害補償條款。

words.definitionZh: 合約中設定賠償責任金額上限的條款

examples.sentence: The limitation of liability clause caps damages at the contract value.
examples.translationZh: 責任限制條款將賠償金額上限設為合約金額。

words.definitionZh: 因違約而須向受害方支付的金錢賠償總額

examples.sentence: The court awarded damages of $200,000 for lost profits.
examples.translationZh: 法院裁定損失利潤賠償金額為二十萬美元。

words.definitionZh: 非直接但由違約間接引發的（損害）

examples.sentence: The contract excludes liability for consequential loss of revenue.
examples.translationZh: 合約排除間接收入損失的賠償責任。

words.definitionZh: 伴隨違約附帶發生的（費用或損失）

examples.sentence: Incidental costs such as inspection fees may be claimed.
examples.translationZh: 附帶費用如檢驗費可主張賠償。

words.definitionZh: 旨在懲罰故意不當行為的（賠償）

examples.sentence: Punitive damages were sought for the supplier's willful misconduct.
examples.translationZh: 因供應商故意不當行為而尋求懲罰性賠償。

words.definitionZh: 合約預先約定違約時須支付固定金額的（損害賠償）

examples.sentence: Liquidated damages of $1,000 per day apply for late delivery.
examples.translationZh: 逾期交貨每日須支付一千美元的違約金。

words.definitionZh: 合約成立所需雙方各自提供的對價（金錢或服務）

examples.sentence: Without valid consideration, a contract may not be legally binding.
examples.translationZh: 沒有有效對價，合約可能不具法律約束力。

words.definitionZh: 締結合約時一方提出的具體要約

examples.sentence: The buyer made a formal offer to purchase the property.
examples.translationZh: 買方正式提出購買該不動產的要約。

words.definitionZh: 無條件同意對方要約以成立合約的行為

examples.sentence: Acceptance must match the terms of the offer to form a contract.
examples.translationZh: 承諾必須符合要約條款才能成立合約。

words.definitionZh: 對原要約提出修改條件的反要約

examples.sentence: The seller rejected the bid and sent a counteroffer at a higher price.
examples.translationZh: 賣方拒絕出價並以較高價格發出反要約。

words.definitionZh: 一旦成立即對各方產生法律拘束效力的

examples.sentence: Once signed, the agreement is legally binding on all parties.
examples.translationZh: 一旦簽署，協議對所有各方均具法律約束力。

words.definitionZh: 法院可強制命令履行的（條款或合約）

examples.sentence: A verbal agreement may not be enforceable in a court of law.
examples.translationZh: 口頭協議在法庭上可能不具強制執行力。

words.definitionZh: 因符合法律要件（要約、承諾、對價）而合法成立的

examples.sentence: A valid contract requires offer, acceptance, and consideration.
examples.translationZh: 有效合約需要要約、承諾和對價。

words.definitionZh: 符合現行法律規定、不違法的

examples.sentence: The legal team reviewed the agreement before it was signed.
examples.translationZh: 法律團隊在合約簽署前進行了審查。

words.definitionZh: 遵守合約條款或相關法規的要求

examples.sentence: All vendors must comply with the data protection requirements.
examples.translationZh: 所有供應商必須遵守資料保護要求。

words.definitionZh: 完整達成合約所規定的全部義務

examples.sentence: The contractor fulfilled all obligations ahead of schedule.
examples.translationZh: 承包商提前完成了所有合約義務。

words.definitionZh: 按合約承諾執行具體的工作或服務

examples.sentence: The agency agreed to perform the audit within 30 days.
examples.translationZh: 機構同意在30天內執行審計工作。

words.definitionZh: 正式提交款項或文件以履行合約義務

examples.sentence: The contractor will tender payment within five business days.
examples.translationZh: 承包商將在五個工作日內正式提交款項。

words.definitionZh: 已超過合約約定期限尚未完成的（付款或義務）

examples.sentence: The invoice is 30 days overdue and interest charges now apply.
examples.translationZh: 發票已逾期30天，現將收取利息費用。

words.definitionZh: 恢復因違約或暫停而失效的合約效力

examples.sentence: The contract will be reinstated once the outstanding payment is made.
examples.translationZh: 一旦補清欠款，合約將恢復效力。

words.definitionZh: 暫時中止合約義務的履行

examples.sentence: Services will be suspended if payment is not received by Friday.
examples.translationZh: 若週五前未收到付款，服務將暫停。

words.definitionZh: 將糾紛提交仲裁人作出具約束力裁決

examples.sentence: The parties agreed to arbitrate rather than litigate the claim.
examples.translationZh: 雙方同意以仲裁而非訴訟方式解決索賠。

words.definitionZh: 擔任中立調解人主持雙方達成妥協

examples.sentence: An independent expert was called in to mediate the contract dispute.
examples.translationZh: 邀請了一位獨立專家來調解合約糾紛。

words.definitionZh: 達成最終協議使合約爭議得以解決

examples.sentence: The two sides resolved the pricing dispute through negotiation.
examples.translationZh: 雙方透過談判解決了定價糾紛。

words.definitionZh: 合約明定提起訴訟或仲裁程序的特定城市或場所

examples.sentence: The agreed venue for arbitration is the ICC in Paris.
examples.translationZh: 約定的仲裁地點是巴黎國際商會。

words.definitionZh: 適用於本合約情況的（法規或條款）

examples.sentence: All applicable tax laws must be observed when invoicing.
examples.translationZh: 開立發票時須遵守所有適用的稅法。

words.definitionZh: 影響後續相似案件判決方向的先例

examples.sentence: The ruling set a precedent for how similar contracts are enforced.
examples.translationZh: 該裁決為類似合約的執行方式樹立了先例。

words.definitionZh: 由立法機關正式制定的成文法律

examples.sentence: The clause must conform to the statute of limitations in this state.
examples.translationZh: 該條款必須符合本州的時效法規。

words.definitionZh: 與政府監管機關規定相關的

examples.sentence: The vendor must meet all regulatory requirements before delivery.
examples.translationZh: 供應商在交貨前必須符合所有監管要求。

words.definitionZh: 擁有法律或行政管轄權的政府主管機關

examples.sentence: The agreement must be filed with the relevant regulatory authority.
examples.translationZh: 協議必須向相關監管機關備案。

words.definitionZh: 政府核准特定活動或工程的書面許可證

examples.sentence: The contractor must obtain a building permit before work begins.
examples.translationZh: 承包商在施工前必須取得建築許可證。

words.definitionZh: 證明個人或產品符合特定標準的官方認證

examples.sentence: The supplier's ISO certification is required under this contract.
examples.translationZh: 本合約要求供應商提供ISO認證。

words.definitionZh: 在主管機關登記以取得法律保護的正式程序

examples.sentence: Trademark registration must be completed before product launch.
examples.translationZh: 商標登記必須在產品上市前完成。

words.definitionZh: 依合約規定程序正式結束合約關係

examples.sentence: Either party may terminate the agreement with 60 days' written notice.
examples.translationZh: 任一方可提前60天書面通知終止協議。

words.definitionZh: 依法須對損害或違約後果承擔賠償責任的

examples.sentence: The contractor is liable for any damage caused during installation.
examples.translationZh: 承包商須對安裝過程中造成的任何損害負責。

words.definitionZh: 將主合約中部分工作委託給另一方承包

examples.sentence: The main contractor may subcontract electrical work to specialists.
examples.translationZh: 總承包商可將電氣工程分包給專業廠商。

words.definitionZh: 與發包方簽訂合約、負責執行工程或服務的廠商

examples.sentence: The contractor must complete all work by the deadline in the contract.
examples.translationZh: 承包商必須在合約規定的期限內完成所有工作。

words.definitionZh: 接受承包商委託執行部分工程或服務的次承包商

examples.sentence: The subcontractor is bound by the same quality standards as the main contractor.
examples.translationZh: 次承包商受與主承包商相同的品質標準約束。

words.definitionZh: 談判，協商

examples.sentence: We need to negotiate the terms of the contract.
examples.translationZh: 我們需要協商合約的條款。

words.definitionZh: 保固，保證書

examples.sentence: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
examples.translationZh: 這台筆電附有兩年保固。

words.definitionZh: 在合約中明確指定特定條件或要求

examples.sentence: The agreement stipulates that payment is due within 30 days.
examples.translationZh: 協議規定付款須在30天內完成。

words.definitionZh: 合約中所明定的特定條件或前提要求

examples.sentence: Meeting the quality stipulation is required before final payment.
examples.translationZh: 在最終付款前須符合品質規定。

words.definitionZh: 部分條款無效時其餘條款仍具效力的可分性原則

examples.sentence: The severability clause protects the contract if one term is void.
examples.translationZh: 可分性條款確保某條款無效時合約仍然有效。

words.definitionZh: 依合約義務補償對方因特定事由所受的損失

examples.sentence: The supplier agreed to indemnify the buyer for any defective goods.
examples.translationZh: 供應商同意就任何瑕疵商品賠償買方。

words.definitionZh: 合約約定補償損失或損害的保障責任（區別於indemnification的條款名稱）

examples.sentence: The firm purchased indemnity insurance to cover potential claims.
examples.translationZh: 公司購買了賠償責任保險以涵蓋潛在索賠。

words.definitionZh: 要求返還所得利益以恢復受害方原狀的法律救濟

examples.sentence: The court ordered restitution of all funds received under the contract.
examples.translationZh: 法院命令退還依合約收取的所有款項。

words.definitionZh: 以新義務或新當事方取代原合約義務的更替協議

examples.sentence: A novation was required when the original supplier sold its business.
examples.translationZh: 原供應商出售業務時需要簽署更替協議。

words.definitionZh: 撤銷合約使雙方回復簽約前狀態的法律救濟

examples.sentence: Rescission of the contract was granted due to mutual mistake.
examples.translationZh: 因雙方共同錯誤，法院准許撤銷合約。

words.definitionZh: 明確拒絕承認或拒絕履行合約義務

examples.sentence: The contractor repudiated the agreement citing financial hardship.
examples.translationZh: 承包商以財務困難為由拒絕履行協議。

words.definitionZh: 一方在合約到期前明確表示拒絕履行義務的行為

examples.sentence: Anticipatory repudiation allows the other party to sue immediately.
examples.translationZh: 預期違約使他方得立即提起訴訟。

words.definitionZh: 違約後受害方採取合理步驟減少損失的法律義務

examples.sentence: The buyer has a duty of mitigation to minimize losses after a breach.
examples.translationZh: 買方有義務在違約後採取措施減少損失。

words.definitionZh: 採取合理行動以降低違約所造成的損失

examples.sentence: The company acted to mitigate losses after the supplier defaulted.
examples.translationZh: 供應商違約後，公司採取行動減少損失。

words.definitionZh: 僅存在於合約當事方之間的法律關係

examples.sentence: Privity of contract prevents a third party from enforcing its terms.
examples.translationZh: 合約的相對性使第三方無法主張其條款。

words.definitionZh: 禁止當事方否認其先前陳述或行為的法律原則

examples.sentence: By estoppel, the seller cannot deny the quality assurance it gave.
examples.translationZh: 依禁反言原則，賣方不得否認其所給予的品質保證。

words.definitionZh: 基於信任與誠信、須以對方最大利益行事的

examples.sentence: The trustee owes a fiduciary duty to act in the beneficiary's interest.
examples.translationZh: 受託人負有以受益人利益為優先的受託義務。

words.definitionZh: 依合約或信託而獲得利益的一方

examples.sentence: The beneficiary receives payment once all conditions are satisfied.
examples.translationZh: 在所有條件滿足後，受益人將收到款項。

words.definitionZh: 承諾在主債務人違約時代為履行義務的保證人

examples.sentence: The bank required a guarantor before approving the corporate loan.
examples.translationZh: 銀行在批准企業貸款前要求提供保證人。

words.definitionZh: 對他方債務承擔連帶清償責任的保證人或擔保物

examples.sentence: A surety bond was required to guarantee project completion.
examples.translationZh: 需要提供履約保證金以確保專案完成。

words.definitionZh: 由中立第三方代為保管、待條件成就後撥付的款項

examples.sentence: The buyer placed the deposit in escrow pending contract completion.
examples.translationZh: 買方將訂金存入託管帳戶，待合約完成後撥付。

words.definitionZh: 對債務人財產所設定的法律留置權

examples.sentence: The contractor filed a lien on the property for unpaid services.
examples.translationZh: 承包商就未付款的服務對房產申請留置權。

words.definitionZh: 附著於財產上的抵押、留置或其他法律負擔

examples.sentence: The property must be sold free of any encumbrance.
examples.translationZh: 該房產必須在無任何負擔的情況下出售。

words.definitionZh: 因違反合約而喪失特定權利或財產的懲罰性後果

examples.sentence: Failure to renew on time results in forfeiture of the option.
examples.translationZh: 未能及時續約將導致選擇權的喪失。

words.definitionZh: 接受合約權利或義務轉讓的一方

examples.sentence: The assignee assumes all rights previously held by the assignor.
examples.translationZh: 受讓人承接讓與人原先持有的所有權利。

words.definitionZh: 將合約權利或義務轉讓給他人的一方

examples.sentence: The assignor must notify the counterparty of any rights transfer.
examples.translationZh: 讓與人必須通知對方有關任何權利轉讓。

words.definitionZh: 接受財產或權利轉讓的受讓方

examples.sentence: The transferee takes on all liabilities attached to the asset.
examples.translationZh: 受讓方承擔附屬於該資產的所有負債。

words.definitionZh: 將財產或權利轉讓給他人的讓與方

examples.sentence: The transferor warrants clear title to the intellectual property.
examples.translationZh: 讓與方保證對知識產權擁有清晰的所有權。

words.definitionZh: 依租賃合約取得資產使用權的承租方

examples.sentence: The lessee must maintain the leased premises in good condition.
examples.translationZh: 承租人必須妥善維護租賃場所的狀況。

words.definitionZh: 依租賃合約授予他方資產使用權的出租方

examples.sentence: The lessor is responsible for major structural repairs.
examples.translationZh: 出租方負責主要結構性修繕工作。

words.definitionZh: 抵押貸款中接受財產抵押擔保的貸款方

examples.sentence: The mortgagee may foreclose if the borrower defaults on payments.
examples.translationZh: 若借款人違約未還款，抵押權人可取消贖回權。

words.definitionZh: 以財產設定抵押向抵押權人借款的債務方

examples.sentence: The mortgagor pledged the office building as loan security.
examples.translationZh: 抵押人以辦公大樓作為貸款擔保。

words.definitionZh: 依信託協議為受益人持有並管理資產的受託人

examples.sentence: The trustee holds the escrow funds until all conditions are met.
examples.translationZh: 受託人持有託管資金直至所有條件滿足。

words.definitionZh: 被指定以自身名義代他人持有資產或職位的名義人

examples.sentence: The nominee holds the shares on behalf of the beneficial owner.
examples.translationZh: 名義持有人代受益所有人持有股份。

words.definitionZh: 無到期日、永久持續有效的（授權或條款）

examples.sentence: The licensor granted a perpetual right to use the software.
examples.translationZh: 授權方給予了永久的軟體使用權。

words.definitionZh: 源自他人原始創作而衍生出的（作品或授權）

examples.sentence: Derivative works may require a separate license from the rights holder.
examples.translationZh: 衍生作品可能需要向權利人申請單獨授權。

words.definitionZh: 未經授權使用他人智慧財產的侵權行為

examples.sentence: The court found clear infringement of the patented design.
examples.translationZh: 法院認定對受專利保護的設計存在明確侵權。

words.definitionZh: 未經授權挪用他人商業秘密或財產的行為

examples.sentence: The company sued for misappropriation of its trade secrets.
examples.translationZh: 公司就商業秘密被盜用提起訴訟。

words.definitionZh: 正式批准或確認先前所做的行為或協議

examples.sentence: The board must ratify any contract valued above $500,000.
examples.translationZh: 董事會必須批准任何金額超過五十萬美元的合約。

words.definitionZh: 對合約或決議的正式批准與確認程序

examples.sentence: Ratification by the board is needed before the contract takes effect.
examples.translationZh: 合約生效前須經董事會正式批准。

words.definitionZh: 合約中規定可能發生而影響義務生效的未來條件事件

examples.sentence: The deal is subject to a financing contingency.
examples.translationZh: 該交易以取得融資為前提條件。

words.definitionZh: 使合約履行變得異常困難的重大情況變化

examples.sentence: The supplier invoked the hardship clause due to soaring material costs.
examples.translationZh: 供應商因材料成本急升援引了艱困條款。

words.definitionZh: 取代先前的合約、條款或文件使其失效

examples.sentence: This agreement supersedes all prior contracts between the parties.
examples.translationZh: 本協議取代雙方之間所有先前的合約。

words.definitionZh: 在法律衝突中佔優先地位，或在訴訟中勝訴

examples.sentence: The English version shall prevail in case of any translation conflict.
examples.translationZh: 如有翻譯衝突，以英文版本為準。

words.definitionZh: 援引合約條款或法律規定以主張特定權利

examples.sentence: The client invoked the penalty clause after the deadline was missed.
examples.translationZh: 客戶在截止日期未達後援引了罰款條款。

words.definitionZh: 依合約或法律所享有的特定權利或利益

examples.sentence: Employees have a statutory entitlement to a written employment contract.
examples.translationZh: 員工依法有權獲得書面僱傭合約。

words.definitionZh: 豁免特定法律責任的保護

examples.sentence: The clause grants immunity from liability for indirect losses.
examples.translationZh: 該條款賦予對間接損失免責的保護。

words.definitionZh: 合約所界定的工作或服務的涵蓋範圍

examples.sentence: Any work outside the agreed scope requires a change order.
examples.translationZh: 約定範圍以外的任何工作須取得變更指示。

words.definitionZh: 合約要求在特定時限內交付的具體成果或文件

examples.sentence: Each deliverable must be reviewed and approved by the client.
examples.translationZh: 每項交付成果須由客戶審查並批准。

words.definitionZh: 合約或法規所要求的必備條件

examples.sentence: The contractor must hold all requisite permits before starting work.
examples.translationZh: 承包商在開工前必須持有所有必要許可證。

words.definitionZh: 合約義務觸發或生效前須先滿足的先決條件

examples.sentence: Board approval is a prerequisite for signing any major contract.
examples.translationZh: 簽署任何重大合約前，董事會批准是先決條件。

words.definitionZh: 於特定事件或合約簽署之後發生的

examples.sentence: Subsequent amendments must be signed by both parties to be valid.
examples.translationZh: 後續修正必須由雙方簽署才具效力。

words.definitionZh: 與合約文件同時期存在或製作的

examples.sentence: Contemporaneous records were used to clarify the contract's intent.
examples.translationZh: 同期紀錄被用來釐清合約的締約意圖。

words.definitionZh: 在本合約文件內（指文件本身所含內容）

examples.sentence: The obligations herein are binding from the date of execution.
examples.translationZh: 本文件所載義務自執行日起具有約束力。

words.definitionZh: 在本合約以下稱為（用於定義縮寫或簡稱）

examples.sentence: ABC Corporation, hereinafter referred to as the Supplier.
examples.translationZh: ABC公司，以下稱為「供應商」。

words.definitionZh: 前文已提及或定義的

examples.sentence: All aforesaid conditions must be met before disbursement.
examples.translationZh: 撥款前必須滿足前述所有條件。

words.definitionZh: 因合約執行或違約而產生費用或義務

examples.sentence: The client will incur additional charges for scope changes.
examples.translationZh: 客戶將因範疇變更而產生額外費用。

words.definitionZh: 在合約中指累計的總金額或責任上限

examples.sentence: Aggregate liability under this contract shall not exceed $1 million.
examples.translationZh: 本合約下的累計責任上限不得超過一百萬美元。

words.definitionZh: 隨時間累積產生（利息、費用或義務）

examples.sentence: Interest will accrue on overdue payments at 5% per annum.
examples.translationZh: 逾期款項將以每年5%的利率累計產生利息。

words.definitionZh: 對合約規定罰款或費用的減免或削減

examples.sentence: The landlord agreed to a rent abatement during the renovation period.
examples.translationZh: 房東同意在裝修期間給予租金減免。

words.definitionZh: 以自身債權抵銷對方所欠款項的法律權利

examples.sentence: The buyer exercised its right of setoff against the outstanding invoice.
examples.translationZh: 買方對未付款發票行使了抵銷權利。

words.definitionZh: 對他方代墊費用的退款補償

examples.sentence: Travel expenses are subject to reimbursement upon receipt submission.
examples.translationZh: 差旅費在提交收據後可申請報銷。

words.definitionZh: 依合約從帳戶向指定方撥付款項的行為

examples.sentence: Disbursement of loan funds is contingent on document approval.
examples.translationZh: 貸款資金的撥付取決於文件審批。

words.definitionZh: 以一方債務金額抵銷另一方所欠的款項

examples.sentence: The client may offset penalty fees against the final payment.
examples.translationZh: 客戶可從最終款項中扣抵罰款費用。

words.definitionZh: 因未在期限內行使或續簽而自動失效

examples.sentence: The option will lapse if not exercised within 30 days.
examples.translationZh: 若未在30天內行使，選擇權將自動失效。

words.definitionZh: 合約中視為或推定某項事實成立

examples.sentence: Silence shall be deemed acceptance if no reply is given in 10 days.
examples.translationZh: 若10天內未回覆，沉默將被視為接受。

words.definitionZh: 依法律原則解讀並詮釋合約條款的含義

examples.sentence: Ambiguous clauses will be construed against the drafting party.
examples.translationZh: 模糊條款將依不利起草方原則解釋。

words.definitionZh: 對合約條款文義與意圖的法律解釋方式

examples.sentence: Disputes over interpretation shall be resolved by expert determination.
examples.translationZh: 關於解釋的爭議應由專家裁決解決。

words.definitionZh: 合約條款因措詞不清而可能有多種解釋的情況

examples.sentence: Any ambiguity in pricing terms must be clarified before signing.
examples.translationZh: 價格條款中的任何歧義在簽署前必須釐清。

words.definitionZh: 合約中反覆出現的標準化通用條款

examples.sentence: The attorney reviewed the boilerplate clauses for unusual provisions.
examples.translationZh: 律師審查了標準條款中是否有任何異常規定。

words.definitionZh: 合約的全部整體；常見於「整份合約」的法律指稱

examples.sentence: This document constitutes the agreement in its entirety.
examples.translationZh: 本文件構成完整的合約協議。

words.definitionZh: 合約中規定書面文件取代所有先前協議的整合條款

examples.sentence: The merger clause confirms this is the final and complete agreement.
examples.translationZh: 合併條款確認本文件為最終完整的協議。

words.definitionZh: 法院修正合約以反映雙方真實意圖的司法救濟

examples.sentence: Reformation was sought to correct the error in the payment amount.
examples.translationZh: 申請合約更正以修正付款金額中的錯誤。

words.definitionZh: 一方清償他方債務後取得其對第三方求償權的代位

examples.sentence: The insurer's right of subrogation was preserved in the contract.
examples.translationZh: 保險人的代位求償權在合約中予以保留。

words.definitionZh: 對合約或保單正式書面批准或追加的附加條款

examples.sentence: An endorsement extended the insurance coverage to include the new site.
examples.translationZh: 一份批單將保險保障範圍延伸至新廠址。

words.definitionZh: 合約中正式承諾執行或不執行特定行為的義務

examples.sentence: The contractor gave an undertaking to complete the work by March.
examples.translationZh: 承包商作出承諾將在三月前完工。

words.definitionZh: 金融或商務合約中的交易對手方

examples.sentence: Credit risk arises if the counterparty fails to meet its obligations.
examples.translationZh: 若交易對手方未能履行義務，則產生信用風險。

words.definitionZh: 合約中負有履行義務的一方

examples.sentence: The obligor must deliver the goods within the timeframe specified.
examples.translationZh: 義務人必須在規定時限內交付貨物。

words.definitionZh: 合約中有權要求他方履行義務的一方

examples.sentence: The obligee may claim damages if the obligor breaches the contract.
examples.translationZh: 若義務人違約，權利人可主張損害賠償。

words.definitionZh: 違約時要求立即清償全部未到期債務的條款

examples.sentence: Acceleration of the loan was triggered after three missed payments.
examples.translationZh: 三次欠繳後觸發了貸款提前到期條款。

words.definitionZh: 接受爭議各方委任主持仲裁並作出裁決的中立人

examples.sentence: The arbitrator's decision is final and binding on both parties.
examples.translationZh: 仲裁人的裁決對雙方均具終局約束力。

words.definitionZh: 在仲裁或訴訟中提出索賠的一方

examples.sentence: The claimant must file its statement of claim within 30 days.
examples.translationZh: 索賠方必須在30天內提交索賠陳述書。

words.definitionZh: 在仲裁或其他正式程序中回應索賠的一方

examples.sentence: The respondent denied liability and filed a counterclaim.
examples.translationZh: 答辯方否認責任並提出反索賠。

words.definitionZh: 在法院訴訟中提起訴訟的原告方

examples.sentence: The plaintiff sought damages for breach of the service agreement.
examples.translationZh: 原告就服務協議的違約尋求損害賠償。

words.definitionZh: 在法院訴訟中被起訴的被告方

examples.sentence: The defendant argued the contract was void due to misrepresentation.
examples.translationZh: 被告主張因虛偽陳述合約應屬無效。

words.definitionZh: 在法律程序中提交的書面宣誓陳述書

examples.sentence: The director signed an affidavit confirming the terms were agreed.
examples.translationZh: 董事簽署了宣誓書確認條款已獲同意。

words.definitionZh: 正式確認收到文件或同意特定事實的書面聲明

examples.sentence: An acknowledgment of receipt must be signed upon document delivery.
examples.translationZh: 文件交付時須簽署收據確認書。

words.definitionZh: 由公證人正式見證並認證文件以確認其真實性

examples.sentence: The power of attorney must be notarized before use overseas.
examples.translationZh: 授權書在境外使用前必須經公證認證。

words.definitionZh: 透過法律手段強制要求某方採取或停止特定行為

examples.sentence: The court may compel arbitration if a valid clause exists.
examples.translationZh: 若有有效的仲裁條款，法院可強制進行仲裁。

words.definitionZh: 法院透過命令要求某方執行或禁止特定行為

examples.sentence: The court enjoined the company from using the patented technology.
examples.translationZh: 法院禁止該公司使用受專利保護的技術。

words.definitionZh: 依合約承擔補償義務的一方

examples.sentence: The indemnitor is required to cover all legal costs incurred.
examples.translationZh: 補償人須承擔所有產生的法律費用。

words.definitionZh: 依合約受到補償保護的一方

examples.sentence: The indemnitee must notify the indemnitor promptly upon any claim.
examples.translationZh: 受補償方須在收到任何索賠後立即通知補償人。

words.definitionZh: 在法庭外以書面記錄的宣誓證詞

examples.sentence: The witness gave a deposition before the arbitration hearing began.
examples.translationZh: 證人在仲裁聽證會開始前提供了庭外宣誓陳述。

words.definitionZh: 在對方違約時向其追索補償或救濟的法律途徑

examples.sentence: The buyer has full recourse against the seller for any defective goods.
examples.translationZh: 買方就任何瑕疵商品享有向賣方追索的完整權利。

words.definitionZh: 在財產上設定抵押或留置等法律負擔

examples.sentence: The owner may not encumber the asset without the lender's written consent.
examples.translationZh: 業主未經貸款方書面同意不得對資產設定負擔。

words.definitionZh: 使擔保利益取得對抗第三方法律效力的完善程序

examples.sentence: Perfection of the security interest requires filing with the registry.
examples.translationZh: 完善擔保利益需向登記機構辦理登記。

words.definitionZh: 依合約規定收回已支付款項或利益的機制

examples.sentence: The bonus is subject to a three-year clawback if targets are not met.
examples.translationZh: 若未達成目標，獎金須在三年內退還。

words.definitionZh: 僅由合約一方單方面決定或採取的

examples.sentence: Unilateral changes to the contract terms are not permitted.
examples.translationZh: 不允許單方面更改合約條款。

words.definitionZh: 由合約雙方相互同意且對雙方均具拘束力的

examples.sentence: This is a bilateral agreement creating obligations for both parties.
examples.translationZh: 這是一份對雙方均產生義務的雙邊協議。

words.definitionZh: 合約義務尚未完全履行、仍在執行中的

examples.sentence: An executory contract remains in force until all duties are performed.
examples.translationZh: 待履行合約在所有義務完成前持續有效。

words.definitionZh: 採取具體措施修補合約違規或交付缺陷

examples.sentence: The vendor must complete remediation of defects within 14 days.
examples.translationZh: 供應商必須在14天內完成缺陷修補工作。

words.definitionZh: 向潛在供應商發出的正式投標或報價邀請

examples.sentence: The solicitation required vendors to submit proposals by Friday.
examples.translationZh: 招標文件要求供應商於週五前提交建議書。
